# Sparkle Dental PA — Complete Clinical & Practice Documentation

## Complete Service Catalog
1. Custom Porcelain & Ceramic Crowns: Lifelike restorations for severely decayed or broken teeth.
2. Gentle Root Canal Therapy: Endodontic therapy with painless local anesthesia preserving natural teeth.
3. Permanent Dental Implants: Precision titanium posts with custom ceramic crowns.
4. Precision Dental Bridges: Fixed restorations replacing missing teeth.
5. Full & Partial Modern Dentures: Comfort-engineered removable prosthetics.
6. Kids & Pediatric Dentistry: Positive, encouraging dental visits for children.
7. Preventative Cleanings & Screenings: Ultrasonic scaling, digital low-dose x-rays, periodontal checks.
8. Tooth-Colored Composite Fillings: Mercury-free tooth-shaded resin restorations.
9. Gentle Tooth Extractions: Simple and surgical removals with gentle numbing.
10. Cosmetic Dentistry & Bonding: Aesthetic smile corrections and contouring.
11. Professional Teeth Whitening: Take-home prescription bleaching kit packages.
12. Urgent Emergency Dental Relief: Priority same-day appointments for acute dental pain.

## Financial & Insurance Details
- In-Network / Direct Filing: Most dental PPO plans.
- Medicare: Select Medicare HMO dental plans accepted.
- Third-Party Financing: CareCredit healthcare card financing with promotional interest terms.
- Self-Pay: Cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, and personalized in-house payment schedules.
